messages:
noah: heads-up: saw another case of keys flipping owner during short spikes. Support asked for clear rules.

dina: summary of ask: make routing stable for billing/alerts but keep perf benefits when possible.

kevin: proposal: two-tier routing policy: 1) live routing for perf (can route to project), 2) billing routing with commit window. only commit billing after sustain_window.

noah: yes. sustain_window configurable per org; default 45s. while in that window, mark events as billing.state=shadow.

maya: console UX: show "billing state" badge on key detail (shadow|committed) and a brief timeline. searchable by state.

kevin: telemetry: emit routing.intent (perf|billing), billing.state, billing.shadow_bytes, decision_reason. store traces + 1% log sample.

dina: safety: cap per-key shadow commit size per hour and add exponential decay to shadow tokens.

noah: API: POST /keys/:id/billing-policy {mode: "auto"|"pin_org"|"pin_project", sustain_sec, cap_per_hour}. admin only.

maya: ensure billing export includes shadow events so downstream invoicing can reconcile before/after.

audit-bot: Created ticket PLAT-8001: "Key routing stability: billing commit window RFC" assigned to noah (https://tracker/redwood/PLAT-8001).

kevin: next steps: Ill draft RFC with rollout (2% -> 10% -> 100%) and synthetic tests, adding metrics: shadow_commits_total, shadow_rejects_total, avg_shadow_duration.
